headline: Police seize fifty cannabis plants from father-son greenhouse operation
summary: Authorities uncovered a sophisticated cannabis cultivation setup, leading to the arrest of a father and son involved in the illicit operation.
details: Police conducted an operation and seized approximately fifty cannabis plants that were being cultivated using a greenhouse method.
A father and son duo were found to be involved in the illicit cultivation. Both individuals have been apprehended by law enforcement officials.
The raid highlights ongoing efforts by authorities to combat drug cultivation and trafficking across the country.
caption:
Fifty cannabis plants seized in a police raid on a sophisticated greenhouse operation.

Police conducted an operation and seized approximately fifty cannabis plants that were being cultivated using a greenhouse method.

A father and son duo were found to be involved in the illicit cultivation. Both individuals have been apprehended by law enforcement officials.

The raid highlights ongoing efforts by authorities to combat drug cultivation and trafficking across the country.
